description: This file defines the 'RuntimeClass' API object and related types for Kubernetes, including its list, overhead, and scheduling configurations.

classes.name: RuntimeClass
classes.description: Defines a class of container runtime supported in the cluster, including handler, overhead, and scheduling.

classes.name: Overhead
classes.description: Represents resource overhead associated with running a pod.

classes.name: Scheduling
classes.description: Specifies scheduling constraints for nodes supporting a RuntimeClass.

methods.name: Handler
methods.description: Specifies the underlying runtime and configuration for the RuntimeClass.
